UNDP i ÖT ges stöd för en ny fas av projektet Enhancing the democratic rule of law through strengthening the justice system in Timor-Leste/Justice System Programme/JSP. Övergripande målet är att stärka rättssystemet i ÖT att upprätthålla rättssäkerheten och att bidra till ökade kunskaper om rättigheter och tillgång till rättstöd för fattiga och utsatta grupper.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The overall project objective for the UNDP's Justice System Programme in Timor-Leste is to strengthen the justice system in Timor-leste and to maintain legal security and to contribute to increased knowledge about rights and access to legal aid for the poor and vulnerable groups
The project has selected six key areas to follow up on 1. Skill and competences of justice sector actors enhanced 2. Formal justice system decentralised and capacities of all District Courts to administer justice an protect vulnerable groups strengthened 3. Prosecution Service strengthened to ensure effective delivery of criminal justice 4. Capacity of Corrections Services strengthened to uphold public safety and security and meet international minimum standards for the treatment of prisoners 5. Enhanced access to justice for all, and improved public confidence in justice institutions 6. CEO of the Justice Systeme Programme established
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
